scripts.title: BLACKLIST/WHITELIST BY MEY
scripts.script:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local TextChatService = game:GetService("TextChatService")

local blacklisted = {}
local whitelisted = {}

local function sendChatMessage(message)
    pcall(function()
        local channels = TextChatService:WaitForChild("TextChannels")
        local general = channels:WaitForChild("RBXGeneral")
        general:SendAsync(message)
    end)
end

local function findPlayer(partialName)
    local search = partialName:lower()

    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player.Name:lower():sub(1, #search) == search
            or player.DisplayName:lower():sub(1, #search) == search then
            return player
        end
    end

    return nil
end

local function blacklistPlayer(searchName)
    local player = findPlayer(searchName)
    local key = searchName:lower()

    blacklisted[key] = true
    whitelisted[key] = nil

    if player then
        blacklisted[player.Name:lower()] = true
        blacklisted[player.DisplayName:lower()] = true

        sendChatMessage(player.Name .. " has been blacklisted.")

        sendChatMessage(";mute " .. player.Name)

        task.wait(0.5)

        sendChatMessage(";glitch " .. player.Name)
    else
        sendChatMessage(searchName .. " has been blacklisted.")
    end
end

local function whitelistPlayer(searchName)
    local player = findPlayer(searchName)
    local key = searchName:lower()

    whitelisted[key] = true
    blacklisted[key] = nil

    if player then
        whitelisted[player.Name:lower()] = true
        whitelisted[player.DisplayName:lower()] = true

        blacklisted[player.Name:lower()] = nil
        blacklisted[player.DisplayName:lower()] = nil

        sendChatMessage(player.Name .. " has been whitelisted.")
        sendChatMessage(";Enlighten " .. player.Name)
    else
        sendChatMessage(searchName .. " has been whitelisted.")
    end
end

sendChatMessage("Blacklist whitelist script loaded credits to me_meymeyme Use !whitelist username Or !blacklist username")

TextChatService.MessageReceived:Connect(function(message)
    local text = message.Text

    if text:sub(1, 11):lower() == "!blacklist " then
        local username = text:sub(12):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")

        if username ~= "" then
            blacklistPlayer(username)
        end

    elseif text:sub(1, 11):lower() == "!whitelist " then
        local username = text:sub(12):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")

        if username ~= "" then
            whitelistPlayer(username)
        end
    end
end)

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
    task.wait(0.2)

    local username = player.Name:lower()
    local displayName = player.DisplayName:lower()

    if blacklisted[username] or blacklisted[displayName] then
        blacklisted[username] = true
        blacklisted[displayName] = true

        sendChatMessage(";mute " .. player.Name)

        task.wait(0.5)

        sendChatMessage(";glitch " .. player.Name)

    elseif whitelisted[username] or whitelisted[displayName] then
        whitelisted[username] = true
        whitelisted[displayName] = true

        sendChatMessage(";Enlighten " .. player.Name)
    end
end)

local function isEnemy(player)
    if player == LocalPlayer then return false end
    if LocalPlayer.Team and player.Team then
        if LocalPlayer.Team == player.Team then
            return false
        end
    end
    if player.TeamColor == LocalPlayer.TeamColor and LocalPlayer.TeamColor ~= BrickColor.new("White") then
        return false
    end
    return true
end

local function getNearestEnemy()
    local nearestTarget = nil
    local shortestDistance = math.huge
    local myCharacter = LocalPlayer.Character
    
    if not myCharacter or not myCharacter:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then return nil end
    local myRoot = myCharacter.HumanoidRootPart

    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if isEnemy(player) then
            local character = player.Character
            if character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") and character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
                if character.Humanoid.Health > 0 then
                    local distance = (myRoot.Position - character.HumanoidRootPart.Position).Magnitude
                    if distance < shortestDistance then
                        shortestDistance = distance
                        nearestTarget = character
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return nearestTarget
end

local function hasBomb(character)
    local tool = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool") or LocalPlayer.Backpack:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
    if tool then
        return true
    end
    return false
end

local timePassed = 0

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
    if not autoEnabled then return end
    
    local character = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not character or not character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then return end
    local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local rootPart = character.HumanoidRootPart
    
    if hasBomb(character) then
        local enemyChar = getNearestEnemy()
        if enemyChar and enemyChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") and enemyChar:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
            local enemyRoot = enemyChar.HumanoidRootPart
            local enemyHumanoid = enemyChar.Humanoid
            
            humanoid:MoveTo(enemyRoot.Position)
            
            if enemyHumanoid:GetState() == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping then
                humanoid.Jump = true
            end
            
            timePassed = timePassed + (dt * 4)
            local offsetAngle = math.sin(timePassed) * 0.9
            
            local lookAtTarget = CFrame.new(rootPart.Position, enemyRoot.Position)
            local rotatedCFrame = lookAtTarget * CFrame.Angles(0, offsetAngle, 0)
            rootPart.CFrame = rootPart.CFrame:Lerp(rotatedCFrame, dt * 8)
            
            local tool = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool") or LocalPlayer.Backpack:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
            if tool then

                    humanoid:EquipTool(tool)

end)
